verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's remote MCP server exposes a read-write `query_rw` tool, so agents can run INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and schema changes in SQL. Those statements act on whole sets of rows at once. Bulk-scale work is also backed by whole-database uploads, table loads from Postgres/MySQL, scheduled Python Flights jobs for ingest and transformation, and backfills on large Mega instances. Missing for 10: no explicit docs framing these as bulk or batch operations (no limits, transactional guarantees or batch semantics described), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven bulk modifications.
